verdict.rationale: AgentMail is API-first: docs show a full OpenAPI spec and comprehensive API coverage (inboxes, messages, threads, webhooks, websockets, multi-tenancy, custom domains) plus a CLI that mirrors dashboard actions ('without writing code'), suggesting the API is the primary and most complete surface. However, there's no explicit comparison confirming every UI-only feature (e.g., dashboard SDK popovers, onboarding flows) has an API equivalent, and community feedback focuses on UI performance/onboarding issues rather than parity. Missing for 10: explicit UI-vs-API feature parity documentation, independent confirmation that dashboard-only actions are all exposed via API.
